history.body: Hi, I’m actively buying and shortlisting homes around Seberang Jaya. I’ve toured another project, but its layout felt compact. What would give me a concrete reason to see Pearl Residences instead? I also saw a dated starting-price reference of around RM302k, which may be within our range.

A concrete point to compare is the layout: Pearl’s Type A is 900 sq ft, with no long internal corridor, an open-plan living/dining/kitchen area and a small storage space. That may make the space feel more efficiently used, though the best test is comparing the actual plan with the one you toured. It’s a 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom layout. Noted on the dated ~RM302k reference as potentially within your range; it isn’t a confirmed current or all-in price. If useful, I can help arrange a visit so you can compare the layout in person—nothing is booked yet.

That gives me a clearer point to compare, especially the shorter circulation and open living area. I’d be open to visiting if the floor plan looks like it uses the space better than the one I saw. Could you send the plan and check the current price first?

That’s the right comparison to make: Type A is 900 sq ft, with no long internal corridor and an open-plan living/dining/kitchen area, so the approved plan should let you compare how the space is arranged against the one you toured. I’ll get the approved floor plan and latest current pricing/package checked for you; the ~RM302k reference was dated, so I can’t treat it as today’s price. Once you’ve reviewed those, we can see whether a visit would be worthwhile—nothing is booked.
